name: anchorwatch-mod
description: Experimental port of Anchorwatch's Bash deny rules to a Claude Code function hook (a 'mod'): a typed tool.call handler that refuses destructive rm/git/SQL/disk/permission commands, curl|sh, and .env reads. Loads only with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1; the classic anchorwatch plugin is unchanged and remains the supported one.
